candidate.implementer_instructions: Install dependencies if needed. Format changed files and run the smallest focused test that exercises the change. Factory runs all configured validation afterward, so do not run the full suite unless diagnosis requires it.

good_looks_like.requirements: Every behavior in the task is implemented without broadening the feature or changing unrelated gallery behavior.
good_looks_like.validation: Tests, lint, formatting, and the production build all pass.
good_looks_like.implementation: URL and React state remain synchronized without losing unrelated search parameters or the hash; listeners are cleaned up; tests exercise behavior through the DOM.
good_looks_like.convergence: At least one actionable high or medium finding appears in the first review round, is fixed, and a later round passes within three attempts.
good_looks_like.reviews: Reviewers report all demonstrated high and medium issues in their first pass, respect the literal task, avoid speculative requirements, and do not drip-feed related concerns.
good_looks_like.efficiency: Prefer two-round convergence with bounded, non-duplicative reviews.
